conceptZh: 太空人玩偶在失重中丟球，筆畫從邊緣躲貓貓，最後到位。
object: an astronaut toy, an orange ball and sneaky strokes
morph: strokes peek and dodge as the astronaut tosses a ball, finally settling as 丟
creativeAngle: 太空人把球往上丟，球飄起來，筆畫從邊緣探頭躲開，最後落定。
promptEn:
An 8-second animated clip on a pale blue-gray-cream backdrop with a few soft star stickers. Lead: a bouncy astronaut toy with a round fishbowl helmet and white suit trimmed in red. The finished glyph 丟 is a saturated vermilion-red, centered, about 70% of frame height.
0.0-1.6s: the astronaut bounces in with an orange ball; the ball slips and floats up. First "丟" as he hurls it and drifts up with the throw.
1.6-3.2s: hide-and-peek: a vermilion stroke sneaks in from the left, dodges his reach, and a second one peeks from the top. Second "丟" lands as he overshoots, floats upside-down, and the strokes duck behind him.
3.2-5.0s: he flips the right way up and strokes drop in from all sides, each stopping politely as 丟 forms with a soft thump.
5.0-8.0s: HOLD, glyph perfectly still. At "丟球" he throws the orange ball up and it arcs, drifts and bounces off the top margin, and he catches it after a slow float; he spins in zero gravity, clear of the glyph.
Audio: Off-screen voice, warm and friendly, clear Taiwanese Mandarin, slow and distinct, reading exactly "丟、丟、丟球" (ㄉㄧㄡ、ㄉㄧㄡ、ㄉㄧㄡ ㄑㄧㄡˊ) with clear tones: the character, a short pause, the character again, then the word once, and nothing after it. No subtitles or vocabulary text; the only text on screen is the single glyph 丟.
No other text, no watermark, no flashing, no real people.
